services.name: Fishing Reports
services.desc: Torwick's Guiding Service is excited to announce expanding to two new lakes and teaming up with Capt. Hunter! Capt. Hunter will be helping me by offering guided trips on Lake Buchanan, Lake LBJ, and Lake Georgetown. These trips will be targeting a variety of fish including Striper (aka Striped bass), White Bass, Hybrid Bass, and Crappie. During these fishing trips you will be fishing with a combination of live bait and artificial lures. These trips accommodate up to 4 anglers and are ideal for groups who rather fish with bait and want to load the cooler with some quality eating fish! Capt. Hunter is a California native with years of experience captaining sport boats out of San Diego chasing
